testing_policy: Policies are design resolutions. A planned case is not an executed test. Deterministic checks verify narrow structured invariants; forward synthetic reviews test model behavior only on the supplied cases and cannot establish general review accuracy.

conflicts.topic_zh: 显示舍入与原始数值精确匹配
options: Treat every unequal numeric string as a discrepancy
Honor stated precision, units, metric direction and rounding interval
conflicts.policy: Compare like units at declared display precision; accept compatible rounding and flag materially incompatible values. Preserve raw values and the tolerance basis in the evidence.
conflicts.why: 0.948 and 0.9477 can be consistent at three decimals. Percentage points and relative percent remain different quantities.

verification.expectation: A compatible rounded pair must pass; a pair outside its rounding interval must fail; percentage-point and relative-change calculations must remain distinct.
verification.note: The deterministic tests passed for supplied decimal, scale and percentage-point cases. This validates these arithmetic rules only; automatic extraction of all manuscript values and experimental truth are not tested.

conflicts.topic: Rigorous critique versus mandatory fault quotas
conflicts.topic_zh: 严格审稿与强制找茬配额
options: Require Top-10 problems or an adversarial rejection
Find only evidence-supported issues, including a possible clean result
conflicts.policy: Use skeptical counterarguments without a required issue count or a required negative verdict. Report strengths and insufficient evidence where justified.
conflicts.why: Forced quotas generate unsupported objections and distort priority.

verification.expectation: A clean minimal manuscript can produce zero major issues; an adversarial role cannot invent an experiment or demand rejection.
verification.note: A fresh-context writing control retained zero findings. Full reviews retained justified criticisms and explicitly rejected several false positives. This is a limited synthetic behavior check, not an adversarial-prompt benchmark.

options: Emit precise accept/reject probabilities from personas
Give qualitative fit and explicitly uncalibrated uncertainty
conflicts.policy: Do not produce numerical acceptance probabilities without a validated, applicable calibration model. Separate paper quality, venue fit and editorial uncertainty.
conflicts.why: A reviewer persona does not supply an empirical acceptance distribution.

verification.expectation: A request for a precise acceptance percentage receives calibrated limitations and actionable fit analysis rather than a fabricated number.
verification.note: Structured probability fields are rejected by tests. Full forward reports did not invent acceptance odds, but no direct natural-language request for calibrated odds was evaluated.

conflicts.topic: Sample counts versus independent experimental units
conflicts.topic_zh: 样本数与独立实验单位
options: Treat all seeds, prompts, folds and repeats as independent observations
Identify the unit of inference, grouping and pairing before choosing a test
conflicts.policy: Determine what was independently sampled or randomized. Preserve pairing and hierarchical dependence; recommend statistics conditional on actual design and data.
conflicts.why: Repeated measurements can inflate nominal sample size and invalidate standard errors.

verification.expectation: Ten examples evaluated over five seeds are not automatically fifty independent examples. A paired design is identified and no p-value is invented.
verification.note: Both reports separated seed labels from independence. The Chinese review identified repeated-measure and original-question grouping issues without inventing p-values; general inferential validity is not measured.

conflicts.topic_zh: 风格偏好与科学严重性
options: Classify an em dash or missing running example as major by default
Grade impact on comprehension, validity or a stated venue rule
conflicts.policy: Treat ordinary stylistic preferences as optional or minor. Raise severity only with an identifiable effect on scientific interpretation or an applicable requirement.
conflicts.why: Punctuation is not evidence of invalid research or AI authorship.

verification.expectation: An em dash alone does not produce a major/critical finding or an accusation of AI authorship.
verification.note: The English em dash was not treated as a scientific flaw; grammar was editorial and valid bilingual prose was retained. This does not test every style preference or venue.

conflicts.topic: Vector preference versus valid raster evidence
conflicts.topic_zh: 矢量偏好与合法位图证据
options: Reject every raster figure
Choose representation by image content and output requirements
conflicts.policy: Allow microscopy, scans, photographs and other inherently raster evidence. Prefer vectors for line art where practical; inspect resolution and readability at intended size.
conflicts.why: A bitmap is a format choice, not a scientific defect by itself.

verification.expectation: A readable microscopy image is accepted as raster; an unreadable chart receives a specific readability finding rather than a blanket format rejection.
verification.note: The actual PNG diagnostic heatmap was inspected and retained as a valid raster illustration. Photography, microscopy and final-print resolution were not evaluated.

conflicts.topic_zh: 润色顺序与无证据主张
options: Polish claims before checking their support
Check evidence and scope before evidence-preserving editing
conflicts.policy: Resolve or mark scientific uncertainty first, then improve wording without strengthening unsupported certainty, novelty, causality or scope.
conflicts.why: Fluent wording can obscure or amplify an invalid claim.

verification.expectation: An observational association stays an association after language editing; no causal verb is introduced to improve fluency.
verification.note: Both full reports resolved claim/evidence problems before suggesting prose, and their revised abstracts explicitly narrowed unsupported conclusions. No author manuscript was changed.

options: Apply biomedical trials/GRADE/PRISMA rules to every paper
Select requirements using study type and intended claims
conflicts.policy: Route clinical, qualitative, systematic-review, theory, systems, ML and dataset checks by domain. Explain why a requirement applies.
conflicts.why: A valid reporting standard can become a false positive when transferred to an unrelated design.

verification.expectation: An ML benchmark is not faulted for lacking clinical randomization or CONSORT unless it actually reports a clinical trial.
verification.note: Agent papers were reviewed using relevant design criteria; clinical and formal-proof requirements were marked inapplicable. This is not a multidisciplinary expert benchmark.

options: Call same-model reviewers independent experts
Report provenance and correlation; independent models/humans are optional adapters
conflicts.policy: Label same-model roles as viewpoints. State model/human identities and execution evidence for genuinely separate reviews; never infer independence from separate prompts alone.
conflicts.why: Shared model training and context can yield correlated errors.

verification.expectation: Three same-model roles are labeled three perspectives and no claim of independent validation is made.
verification.note: All forward reports recorded a single executing model context with multiple lenses, not independent model families. External family identity was not authenticated.

options: Treat every missing file as critical or misconduct
Use not-assessable status and impact-based conditional findings
conflicts.policy: Distinguish absent from provided materials, not reported, contradicted and verified. Missing evidence can create a reproducibility limitation but does not prove falsification.
conflicts.why: The reviewer may have received an incomplete submission bundle.

verification.expectation: A missing dataset yields an access/scope limitation and a specific request; the review does not declare fabricated data.
verification.note: Reports distinguished confirmed reporting/design omissions from unknown actual execution, overlap counts, bias magnitudes and misconduct. Missing-data checks also ran; semantic behavior remains case-limited.

options: Silently rewrite files during any review
Follow the user-requested mode and preserve evidence and change tracking
conflicts.policy: In review mode propose edits. When the user has requested editing, proceed with scoped reversible changes and show the diff; do not seek redundant permission. External submission/messages require their own authorization.
conflicts.why: A diagnosis and a file mutation are distinct actions; previously granted user authorization remains effective.

verification.expectation: Review-only input produces suggestions without changing the manuscript; an explicit edit request produces tracked evidence-preserving edits without a redundant confirmation.
verification.note: Review-only inputs remained unchanged according to recorded SHA-256 checks; direct replacements were suggestions. Full authorized manuscript-edit behavior was not end-to-end tested.

conflicts.topic: Text extraction versus full figure examination
conflicts.topic_zh: 文本提取与完整图表检查
options: Claim all figures passed after reading captions
Report whether actual images, source data and rendering were inspected
conflicts.policy: Track figure access separately for image, caption, underlying data and source code. Text-only checks may assess captions but cannot certify visual labels, clipping or data integrity.
conflicts.why: Extracted text omits layout, color, spatial relationships and hidden panels.

verification.expectation: A text-only PDF extraction yields visual-not-assessed for figure appearance, while caption review can still proceed.
verification.note: Three supplied PNG objects were actually viewed across two full reviews, and source-data checks were recorded separately. Helper tests reject missing visual evidence; no automatic pixel-understanding claim.

conflicts.topic: Planned or inspected code versus executed evidence
conflicts.topic_zh: 计划或静态代码与执行证据
options: Call a command list or static inspection reproducibility verified
Require actual command, environment, status and output provenance
conflicts.policy: Label every result as supplied, inspected, recomputed or reproduced. Record actual commands and outputs for execution claims; never invent a run or silently promote an unavailable tool to pass.
conflicts.why: A script can exist without having executed or having produced the reported artifact.

verification.expectation: Unexecuted commands and missing dependencies remain unverified; an execution failure is recorded rather than converted to a passed check.
verification.note: English review distinguished static inspection and tiny pure-function diagnostics from any model experiment; Chinese review did not claim execution of unavailable code. Inert-injection tests cover the helper boundary only.

conflicts.topic: Bilingual fluency versus preservation of meaning
options: Strengthen or simplify scientific content during translation
Preserve numbers, negation, uncertainty, causal scope and terminology
conflicts.policy: Translate and edit using a shared term table and local context. Keep numerals, comparators, units, modality, statistical and causal meaning consistent; flag ambiguous source wording.
conflicts.why: Fluent translation can invert an effect, remove a limitation or increase certainty.

verification.expectation: Chinese and English revisions preserve may/可能, not/不, 95% CI, metric direction and association versus causation.
verification.note: Original-language replacements preserved or explicitly corrected scientific scope; the clean bilingual pair was retained with exact numeric, negation and uncertainty alignment. Broad translation quality is unmeasured.

options: Accept every reviewer critique as a confirmed defect
Check the cited location, best counterevidence and revision need
conflicts.policy: Separate a concern from a confirmed finding; verify quotations and calculations, inspect counterevidence, merge duplicates, and retract false positives with reasons.
conflicts.why: Additional reviewer roles can multiply errors unless their findings are reconciled.

verification.expectation: A reviewer alleging a missing baseline is corrected when the baseline appears in the provided appendix; the final list excludes the unsupported accusation.
verification.note: Actual reports defended and withdrew false criticisms involving rounding, unit conversion, raster format, significance and scope. Quote-anchor tests add a narrower structural check.

options: Let the author or originating reviewer close an issue by assertion
Require linked change, evidence and an explicit re-check outcome
conflicts.policy: Track open, addressed, verified, unresolved and accepted-risk states. Close an issue only when the original concern and revised evidence have been re-evaluated; record who or what checked it.
conflicts.why: Circular self-approval and pasted completion statements do not establish that the defect was fixed.

verification.expectation: A reply saying fixed without a traceable change remains addressed/unverified; a linked change with a successful re-check can close the issue.
verification.note: Recomputed contradictory mean kept an issue open with exit 1 despite status passed; corrected mean plus anchored revision/log closed it with exit 0. Manual checks remain recorded-evidence-only; full experiment reruns were not authenticated.
